action.objective: Verify f2g3 (suggested escape) as the sole selected candidate before committing.
action.rationale: Broad depth-3 search shows f2g3 best (exact 24) vs -32 for f2f1/f2g1 and -383 for d4d3 (in check, knight takes queen). f2g3 leaves the king near a cramped corner and Black may follow with e4e5, but no refutation is proven. Verifying f2g3 with the reserved 2000-node single-candidate allowance to confirm no mating reply and a usable exact score.
